803-1809-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-1809-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6157-8337.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1557-4613-5475.easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Forensic Researcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1557-4613-5475.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1557-4613-5475.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

1445-4871-7272-7422.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7272-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

719-4659-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-4659-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

141-2034-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4691-4971-6124.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4691-4971-6124.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Herald of Eternal Dawn.

631-6249-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

222-527-6495-7175.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-7175.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-7175.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

277-851-2557-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

643-3413-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1887-2021-2060-7061.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

670-1619-3734-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima's Student and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-4556-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-5295-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5295-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4802-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

3094-4659-5390-6965-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5390-6965-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-5571-7310--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1475-6798-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

628-4050-7191.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

273-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
273-6556-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6823-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6823-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

372-5231-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2099-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

5078-5642-6747.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.

Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

643-1399-1606-1671.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

413-560-2425-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
413-560-2425-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Zombie and Soldier enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station twice by sacrificing the Zombie or Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining trigger and creature token.
Repeat from step 1.

290-1978-4241.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Karn.

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.

When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

643-997-3413.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

Float at least {10}.

Repeat from step 2 using the Doubling Cube token instead.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

890-1198-1978-2410.notablePrerequisites: Myr Galvanizer, Palladium Myr and Plague Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1198-1978-2410.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Plague Myr by tapping it, adding {C}.

Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.

Freed from the Real attached to Apprentice Wizard.

Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

2178-3478-4913-5310.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
2178-3478-4913-5310.description:

When Bloodghast dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

565-1741-1858.notablePrerequisites:
Lands able to tap for {1}{U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1741-1858.description:
Cast View from Above targeting Cloud of Faeries.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
The token Cloud of Faeries enters, untapping two lands you control.
View from Above resolves, returning to your hand.
Repeat.

2882-2915-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-2915-4675-4694.description:
Cast Lodestone Bauble by paying {0}.
Lodestone Bauble enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
